# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-D: O(1) AI 3.0 Strategic Triggers (0 bare if/else) (oe_ai3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_ai3_tests.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country/global scope triggers for Module 19.0-D (oe_ai3_).
# Strictly yields to v9.9 oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity and respects game rules.

# Any scope. AI 3.0 active guard.
oe_ai3_active_guard = {
	NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
	NOT = { has_game_rule = ai_personalities_random }
}

# Country scope. Healthy independent AI eligible for AI 3.0 personality adaptation.
oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = {
	oe_ai3_active_guard = yes
	is_ai = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	is_during_bankruptcy = no
	num_loans < 4
	war_exhaustion < 8
	stability >= -10
	NOT = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity }
}

# Country scope. Great Power or major regional pole (player or AI).
oe_ai3_is_great_power_actor = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	OR = {
		is_great_power = yes
		num_locations >= 45
	}
}

# Country scope. Fit for Industrial Modernizer AI 3.0 personality.
oe_ai3_is_industrial_modernizer_fit = {
	oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = yes
	current_year >= 1650
	num_locations >= 18
	OR = {
		has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
		has_embraced_institution = institution:scientific_revolution
		has_embraced_institution = institution:industrialization
	}
}

# Country scope. Fit for Maritime Thalassocrat AI 3.0 personality.
oe_ai3_is_maritime_thalassocrat_fit = {
	oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = yes
	num_of_ports >= 8
	OR = {
		navy_size >= 25
		has_colonial_charters = yes
		owns = location:suez
		owns = location:panama
		owns = location:kiel
		owns = location:corinth
	}
}

# Country scope. Fit for Balance-of-Power Arbiter AI 3.0 personality.
oe_ai3_is_balance_arbiter_fit = {
	oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = yes
	is_great_power = yes
	any_rival = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_great_power = yes
		num_locations >= 65
	}
}

# Country scope. Fit for Silk Road Unifier AI 3.0 personality.
oe_ai3_is_silk_road_unifier_fit = {
	oe_ai3_ai_healthy_base = yes
	num_locations >= 25
	OR = {
		has_presence_in = region:persia_region
		has_presence_in = region:khorasan_region
		has_presence_in = region:xinjiang_region
		has_presence_in = region:anatolia_region
		has_presence_in = region:north_china_region
	}
	OR = {
		has_presence_in = region:steppes_region
		has_presence_in = region:crescent_region
		has_presence_in = region:balkan_region
		has_presence_in = region:east_china_region
	}
}

# Any scope. Detects an overmighty continental hegemon threatening Eurasian equilibrium.
oe_ai3_has_hegemon_threat = {
	any_great_power = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		OR = {
			is_hegemon = yes
			num_locations >= 140
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Active naval arms race contender facing a maritime rival.
oe_ai3_is_naval_arms_contender = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	num_of_ports >= 6
	navy_size >= 20
	any_rival = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_of_ports >= 6
		navy_size >= 20
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible for industrial catch-up charter when a neighbor has Manufactories.
oe_ai3_needs_industrial_catchup = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	current_year >= 1660
	num_locations >= 20
	NOT = { has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories }
	any_neighbor_country = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
	}
}
